00042 // A new UGen also needs a UGenInternal which does the actual processing. 
00043 // UGen and its subclasses are primarily for constructing the UGen graphs.
00044 // Simle internals should inherit from UGenInternal.
00045 class MaximaUGenInternal : public UGenInternal
00046 {
00047 public:
00048  // Constructor.
00049  MaximaUGenInternal(UGen const& input) throw();
00050  
00051  UGenInternal* getChannel(const int channel) throw();
00052  
00053  // This is called when the internal is needed to process a new block of samples.
00054  void processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw();
00055  
00056  enum Inputs { Input, NumInputs }; // used mainly by the 'inputs' array for the UGenInternal's UGen inputs
00057  
00058 protected:
00059  bool didIncreaseLastTime;
00060  float lastValue;
00061 };
00062 
00063 // A macro for declaring a UGen subclass.
00064 // The parentheses around the 2nd and 3rd arguments are required.
00065 // Items within these parentheses should be comma-separated just as for argument declarations and calls.
00066 UGenSublcassDeclarationNoDefault
00067 (
00068  Maxima,     // The UGen name, this will inherit from UGen
00069  (input),    // argument list for the Constructor, AR and KR methods as they would be CALLED
00070  (UGen const& input), // argument list for the Constructor, AR and KR methods as they are to be DECLARED
00071  COMMON_UGEN_DOCS  // Documentation (for Doxygen)
00072 );
